scenarios.name: Load probe: --plugin-dir overrides the installed craftflow
scenarios.given: an empty scratch project with a .craftflow/state dir, CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT / CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID unset and CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR pointing at the scratch project
scenarios.when: claude -p --plugin-dir plugins/craftflow --model haiku --debug-file <file> runs a one-word prompt
scenarios.then: the debug log contains 'from --plugin-dir overrides installed version' at least once, proving the worktree plugin (not the installed one) is what the live scenarios exercise
scenarios.command: SCR=$(mktemp -d) && mkdir -p "$SCR/p1/.craftflow/state" && PLUGIN="$PWD/plugins/craftflow" && (cd "$SCR/p1" && env -u CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT -u CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR="$SCR/p1" claude -p --plugin-dir "$PLUGIN" --model haiku --debug-file "$SCR/dbg.txt" "Reply OK" >/dev/null 2>&1); N=$(grep -c 'from --plugin-dir overrides installed version' "$SCR/dbg.txt"); rm -rf "$SCR"; echo "load_probe_hits=$N"; test "$N" -ge 1

scenarios.name: Round-trip LV-1..LV-6 against the real CLI
scenarios.given: the worktree plugin loaded via --plugin-dir and a scratch plugin copy with contextNudge on, warnTokens 1000, criticalTokens 100000000, assumedWindow 200000000
scenarios.when: context_nudge_roundtrip.py drives real haiku sessions through default audit (LV-1), the warn nudge reaching the model once (LV-2), critical escalation (LV-3), /compact reset without a stale re-nudge (LV-4), the --boundary relay against the live transcript (LV-5) and CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID parity (LV-6)
scenarios.then: the driver prints the summary JSON with load_probe PASS and evidence_class A, every lv PASS or the allowed LIMITATION for lv4/lv6, and exits 0

scenarios.name: Compact line + user override LVC-1..LVC-5
scenarios.given: the worktree plugin loaded via --plugin-dir with its shipped audit config UNCHANGED, a scratch plugin copy with contextNudge on for the corrupt/off cases, scratch user override files (on, corrupt, off) reached through CRAFTFLOW_CONTEXT_NUDGE_USER_CONFIG, and a seeded live workflow artifact without session_id
scenarios.when: context_nudge_compact_roundtrip.py drives real haiku sessions: a user file turns the nudge on and the bound /compact line reaches the model (LVC-1), the generic line when no workflow is mentioned (LVC-2), a corrupt user file falls back to the plugin values (LVC-3), a user file off silences an on plugin (LVC-4), and the --boundary relay carries the same line into the checkpoint (LVC-5)
scenarios.then: the driver prints the summary JSON with load_probe PASS, lvc1..lvc5 PASS (lvc1 may be LIMITATION:env_not_propagated_to_hooks), second_copy_detected false, plugin_config_unchanged true and evidence_class A, and exits 0

scenarios.name: Timing on the largest real transcript
scenarios.given: the largest *.jsonl under ~/.claude/projects (hundreds of MB), a temp plugin root and project in audit mode, a real-size activeContext.md, and the v1.19.0 release script (a70b49a08c5731021261ca1fe7d6c7c260ed50d2) as pinned A/B baseline
scenarios.when: context_nudge_timing.py times in-process current_context_tokens x50, 20 interleaved bare-vs-hook subprocess runs, 10 --boundary audit runs, and 30 interleaved A/B pairs per variant (no-change with the user file absent, no-change with a valid four-key user file, nudge) plus the in-process workflow lookup
scenarios.then: inproc_median_ms < 50, boundary_median_ms < 1000, boundary_max_ms < 2600, ab_nochange_absent_median_ms <= 8, ab_nochange_override_median_ms <= 8, ab_nudge_median_ms <= 15, lookup_median_ms <= 10, lookup_max_ms <= 40, and absolute_gate is not fail (delta_median_ms < 50 is enforced only when the 1-minute load is at most the CPU count, else inconclusive_load); the driver exits 0 and never prints transcript content. Limitation: the scenario always measures current vs v1.19.0, so later releases fold into the number; the next change to the nudge hot path re-pins the SHA
scenarios.expected: exit 0; gate_pass true; every relative gate under budget; absolute_gate pass or inconclusive_load
